title: #142 Real Life
prompt: Media make people lose contact with real life, do you agree or disagree.

promptSegments.text: Media make people lose contact with real life, do you agree or disagree.

hardVocabulary.enGloss: A key word in this prompt.
A key word in this prompt.

requirements.en: State how far you agree or disagree.
requirements.vi: Nêu mức độ đồng ý hoặc không đồng ý.

requirements.en: Support your position with two clear reasons.
requirements.vi: Hỗ trợ quan điểm bằng hai lý do rõ ràng.

requirements.en: Use relevant examples when they strengthen an idea.
requirements.vi: Dùng ví dụ phù hợp khi chúng làm rõ ý.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Media use takes time away from real life activities.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Media use takes time away from real life activities.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Media makes real connections harder to find.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Media makes real connections harder to find.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Media helps keep important relationships by allowing people to talk to friends far away.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Media helps keep important relationships by allowing people to talk to friends far away.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Media is a useful learning tool because it gives people access to many kinds of information.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Media is a useful learning tool because it gives people access to many kinds of information.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The first point argues that media changes how people interact, leading to reduced face-to-face communication skills and lower quality of real-world connections.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The first point argues that media changes how people interact, leading to reduced face-to-face communication skills and lower quality of real-world connections.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Secondly, media offers an easy escape from daily life problems through constant entertainment in virtual worlds, causing people to neglect important responsibilities.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Secondly, media offers an easy escape from daily life problems through constant entertainment in virtual worlds, causing people to neglect important responsibilities.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Media platforms help maintain strong connections with friends and family who live far away, allowing people to share important moments and feel less alone.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Media platforms help maintain strong connections with friends and family who live far away, allowing people to share important moments and feel less alone.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Media offers numerous opportunities for learning and personal growth by providing access to knowledge from top universities globally.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Media offers numerous opportunities for learning and personal growth by providing access to knowledge from top universities globally.

promptTraps.en: Do not write a general essay about the topic without answering the exact task.
promptTraps.vi: Không viết bài chung chung về chủ đề mà không trả lời đúng yêu cầu của đề.

promptTraps.en: Do not explain the statement without making your own position clear.
promptTraps.vi: Không chỉ giải thích nhận định mà quên nêu rõ quan điểm cá nhân.

faq.questionVi: Đề này đang hỏi điều gì?
faq.answerEn: Break the prompt into its direct requirements before choosing ideas.
faq.answerVi: Hãy tách đề thành các yêu cầu trực tiếp trước khi chọn ý.

faq.questionEn: How many main ideas should I use?
faq.questionVi: Tôi nên dùng bao nhiêu ý chính?
faq.answerEn: Use two developed points with explanation and relevant examples.
faq.answerVi: Dùng hai luận điểm được phát triển bằng giải thích và ví dụ phù hợp.

faq.questionEn: Can I use a personal example?
faq.questionVi: Tôi có thể dùng ví dụ cá nhân không?
faq.answerEn: Yes, if it directly supports the point and remains relevant to the prompt.
faq.answerVi: Có, nếu ví dụ trực tiếp hỗ trợ luận điểm và vẫn liên quan đến đề.

faq.answerEn: Avoid memorised general sentences and any idea that does not answer the task.
faq.answerVi: Tránh câu chung học thuộc và mọi ý không trả lời đúng yêu cầu.
